The '''Morel''' is a mushroom found in the [[Spring]] via [[foraging]] in the [[Secret Woods]] or on the [[Farm Maps#Forest|Forest Farm]]. It can also be found in [[The Cave|the Farm Cave]] after choosing the mushroom option, or produced by a [[Mushroom Log]]. One Morel may be purchased from [[George]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|30|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

==Tailoring==
The Morel is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt257.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Morel Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
The Morel is not used in any [[quests]].
